text_block_list.text: I was invited to a hero show organized by Biko Pegasus and her friends, but...

text_block_list.name: Evil Henchmen
text_block_list.text:
"I'll zap you with my Late-Night Beam so you can't sleep tonight~!
Now, who should I pick~...?"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Aah, jeez! It's so frustrating!
I can't just stand by and watch!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to say a weapon's effect AFTER you use it!
That makes it way more terrifying bit by bit!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Besides, decide what you want before stepping up! If you pick here, it'll take forever—!!
That's far enough!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The ally of justice, Biko Pegasus, is here!!
I'll protect the peace of this town!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Take this!!
Pegasus PAAANCH!!

text_block_list.name: Evil Henchmen
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahahaa!!
Justice will always prevail!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez! I knew this would happen—
Take this, Late-Night BEEEEAM!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Waaaah~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Kh... What?!
I thought I defeated the enemy! Who is that?!
Heh-heh-heh~! The one you just defeated was merely one of my henchmen~!

text_block_list.name: Night Owl Buono
text_block_list.text: Give it up, Biko Pegasus!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That last battle drained all my power...!

Though Biko Pegasus had fallen into a dire pinch,
after hearing the children's cheers of encouragement,
she regained her strength—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Take this, Pegasus Kiiiiick!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it?
Pretty cool show, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, everyone was so hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You were super cool, nanoda!!
Um—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The Late-Night Fiend, Buono, appears!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Have the minion distract the hero, followed by a calm and cool entrance!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A true evil mastermind!! That's exactly what Windy-chan wants to become!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: To do that, first I need henchmen...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list: Why are you staring at me?
Why are you staring at me?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I already had a minion. Now I just need to train them up to make me look even better.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen up to Windy-chan—er, no,
listen to what the Boss tells ya!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna whip you into shape, so get ready--!!
choice_data_list: Doing evil deeds is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What was that—you defying the Boss—!
People like you get punished~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Stop it, Windy-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho~ Trying to stand in my way, Biko Pegasus?!
No one can stop Winde-chan!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is the show starting again?
Yaaay!!

Afterward, cheered on by the children,
the battle between Shinko Windy and Biko Pegasus took place.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi! That's what I like to hear!
This makes training you worth it!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Mmm! As a hero, I can't just stand by and watch evil be born!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm putting a stop to this right here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaa!
Not a bad opponent for a debut battle!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Do it, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The show's starting again?
Looks like there's a new villain too!!

Afterward, cheered on by the children,
the battle between justice and evil took place.
